title: Absorb g copies of the heavy slice by the factor-4 gate (no new κ)
body:
## Summary

The `g` copies of the heavy slice fit the factor-4 gate. For integers `p ≥ 2`, `g ≥ 1`, `K ≥ 0` and `C ≥ 0`, whenever `p ≥ max(64, 4K + 2C)` and `4 g ceil(log2 p) ≤ p`, `g` copies of

```text
(p^{10})^{g-1} p^6 (1 + p^4) exp(K p - p^2)
```

are strictly below `2^{-C p}`. The gate forces `g < 2^L`, so the copies add one `L`. For `p ≥ 64`, `8 L ≤ p`, and `32 L` becomes `4 p`. Four times the eighths is then at most `84 p + 32 - 16 p^2`. The polynomial `16 p^2 - 84 p - 64` equals `60096` at `p = 64` and increases by `32 p - 68`, so the exponent is at most `-C p - 1`.

At `p = 84` and `g = 3`, `4 g L = 84 ≤ 84` while `5 g L = 105 > 84`, and the copies exponent is `-6838`. This `4` multiplies `g L`. The coefficient-9 monomials in #4495 still use `16 g L ≤ p`, because `9 > 8`. At `p = 2` and `g = 2` the hypothesis fails. Since `e < 3`, two copies are larger than `1`.

A factor smaller than `4` stays open. The trailing bound `p^{10}`, the section error, and the ceiling `9 p^2` stay hypotheses. This package does not prove `||H^{-1}||_2 ≤ p^{10}`. No new κ. The selected record is `60403/20000000`. This answers the open question of #4673. It branches from fetched main and does not replay that unmerged package.

## Test plan

- [x] Prints `PASS_GAUSSIAN_SLICE_FOUR_COPIES` and `outcome=completed`
- [ ] Maintainer replay was not run

Base `b58ad9ef4d4e861b0eaa5dba41742bdc072dca51`, priority revision 7. Upstream fetched at 2026-10-22T15:27:47Z was that commit. The pre-submit fetches at 2026-10-22T15:29:17Z and 2026-10-22T15:29:33Z were the same commit, and the pinned blobs match. κ remains `60403/20000000`.
